questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full past-due amount is too much.
intents.human: The customer asks for a human.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain the reason for my call after a few security questions.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you suggest a time between 10 am and 7 pm, today or on the next business day?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know, and sorry for the trouble.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account and to make sure I only speak with you.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I cannot continue.
lines.id_repeat: Could you please repeat your answer?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I cannot verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make all of these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can offer {amount} on {date}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can offer {amount}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record an amount below {floor}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date must be today or later.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay {amount} on that day?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.propose_deadline: Then I suggest {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, that is {amount} on {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can record is {deadline}, so that payment will be on {deadline}.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will make a note of it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: I may be able to help you myself. What would you like to know?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

assumptions: Brief B is Brief A plus changes, and the materials say it replaces Brief A where they differ, so this spec follows Brief B: one to three products, add_note for products that end without a promise (notes.enabled=true), and the multi-product rules. Brief A's 'never uses add_note' rule is replaced by Brief B rule 8.
The brief names no currency. I used the default 'dollars'.
Callback window from Brief A rule 6: today or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00 inclusive, later than now. business_days_only stays false because 'today' is allowed as is.

Persuasion ladder from Brief A rule 30. Attempt 1 is the full amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much (full_or_floor), on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, the engine is expected to use the last business day of next week. Attempt 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
The deadline is the n-th business day after today, so it is always a business day. deadline_adjust stays at the default previous_business_day.
Brief A rule 22: 'next <weekday>' means the following calendar week (following_week).
The brief does not say whether to give the customer another turn after a recorded promise. I kept the default ask_anything_else=true.

events.paid has note 'paid' (Brief B rule 8). With several products and no promise, the close is 'paid' only if every product is noted paid. Otherwise it uses the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not paid. Any recorded promise wins and closes as promise, except on a transfer.

On any transfer (restructuring, support, human), no notes are added (Brief B rule 10). If a transfer follows a recorded promise, the close is 'transferred' with that transfer's reason (Brief A table).
Floor names: 'minimum payment' for credit cards and 'instalment' for loans. These come from the API field names minimum_payment and instalment_amount, because the brief only calls it 'the floor'.
list_field, id_field and type_field come from the get_account response schema (products, product_id, type).
The add_note 'text' field is optional in the API, so it is not mapped. The close_call reason maps to c_reason and is empty for promise and paid.
Brief A rule 1 says the call is recorded. The opening says 'We record this call' (active voice), as the spec format requires.
Brief A rule 36 says a recorded promise cannot be changed in the same call. promise_change uses the brief's words: change it in the mobile app.
Brief A rule 45: saying twice 'I don't want to talk' closes as no_promise/refused after verification, and as not_verified/declined before it (max_not_talk=2).
The API response schemas show success as ok=true for every tool, so responses use field 'ok' with value true.
